title: The Strategic Value of Platform Encroachment: Seller Entry and Network Effects
title_zh: 平台入侵的战略价值：卖家进入与网络效应
title_primary: 平台入侵的战略价值：卖家进入与网络效应
title_secondary: The Strategic Value of Platform Encroachment: Seller Entry and Network Effects
authors: Salvatore Piccolo, Shiva Shekhar, Jorge Padilla, Marco Pagnozzi
abstract: In a platform market where user participation is endogenous and shaped by direct network effects, we compare the competitive and welfare effects of two alternative business models: pure intermediation and ‘encroachment’ — a hybrid model where the platform competes with third-party sellers by selling its own private-label products. There are two groups of sellers: entrants, who must pay a specialization cost to access the marketplace, and incumbents, who have already paid it. With encroachment, the platform has no incentive to entirely foreclose their downstream rivals if there are positive network effects. Surprisingly, although encroachment restricts entry, it increases consumer surplus, total welfare, and the incumbents’ profit when there is a sufficiently large number of incumbents in the marketplace.
abstract_zh: 在用户参与内生且受直接网络效应影响的平台市场中，我们比较了两种替代商业模式——纯中介与“入侵”（一种平台通过销售自有品牌产品与第三方卖家竞争的混合模式）——的竞争与福利效应。市场中有两组卖家：进入者，需支付专业化成本才能进入市场；以及在位者，已支付该成本。在入侵模式下，若存在正网络效应，平台没有动机完全排挤其下游竞争对手。令人意外的是，尽管入侵限制了进入，但当市场中在位者数量足够多时，它反而提高了消费者剩余、总福利以及在位者的利润。

title: The Impact of US Export Controls on the Capacity Utilisation of Chinese Enterprises: An Empirical Study Based on the Entity List
title_zh: 美国出口管制对中国企业产能利用率的影响：基于实体清单的实证研究
title_primary: 美国出口管制对中国企业产能利用率的影响：基于实体清单的实证研究
title_secondary: The Impact of US Export Controls on the Capacity Utilisation of Chinese Enterprises: An Empirical Study Based on the Entity List
authors: Hang Liu, Nana Nan, Peichao Guo
abstract: The US Entity List policy, by severing access to critical intermediate inputs and technology transfers for specific Chinese enterprises, potentially exacerbates supply ‐ demand imbalance. Using panel data of Chinese listed enterprises from 2010 to 2023, this paper treats the imposition of Entity List sanctions on enterprises as a quasi‐natural experiment, with the aim of assessing the causal impact of these sanctions on enterprise capacity utilisation (CU). The empirical results indicate that: (1) The Entity List has led to a significant decline in the CU of Chinese enterprises; (2) The Entity List suppresses CU primarily by deteriorating enterprise performance and tightening financing constraints; (3) University‐industry collaboration and government subsidies serve as effective mitigating factors, significantly alleviating the negative impact of the Entity List on CU; (4) Heterogeneity analysis demonstrates that the negative impact is more pronounced for enterprises characterised by higher asset depreciation rates, weaker market competitiveness, greater centralised supplier concentration and those not deploying within the Belt and Road countries. These findings demonstrate that the US Entity List has driven China's structural contradictions to spread into high‐tech industries, no longer confined solely to traditional sectors such as steel and cement. Simultaneously, the results highlight the critical role of knowledge spillovers from domestic universities and strategic government support in helping enterprises withstand shocks like supply disruptions.
abstract_zh: 美国实体清单政策通过切断特定中国企业获取关键中间投入品和技术转让的渠道，可能加剧供需失衡。利用2010年至2023年中国上市企业面板数据，本文将企业遭受实体清单制裁视为准自然实验，旨在评估制裁对企业产能利用率的因果影响。实证结果表明：（1）实体清单导致中国企业产能利用率显著下降；（2）实体清单主要通过恶化企业绩效和收紧融资约束来抑制产能利用率；（3）产学研合作与政府补贴作为有效的缓解因素，显著减轻了实体清单对产能利用率的负面影响；（4）异质性分析显示，对于资产折旧率较高、市场竞争力较弱、供应商集中度较高以及未在“一带一路”国家布局的企业，负面影响更为显著。这些发现表明，美国实体清单已推动中国结构性矛盾向高科技产业蔓延，不再局限于钢铁、水泥等传统行业。同时，结果凸显了国内大学知识溢出和战略性政府支持在帮助企业抵御供应中断等冲击中的关键作用。

title: Contagion, migration, and misallocation in a pandemic
title_zh: 疫情中的传染、迁移与资源错配
title_primary: 疫情中的传染、迁移与资源错配
title_secondary: Contagion, migration, and misallocation in a pandemic
authors: Qing Chang, Ke Tang, Danxia Xie, Longtian Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study how individuals' migration decisions during a pandemic interact with the spatial allocation of hospital resources, characterizing both the laissez-faire equilibrium and the planner's allocation in closed form. Susceptible individuals leave high-infection cities while infected individuals move toward better-resourced ones, but these private decisions diverge from the planner's along two dimensions. First, the migration of infected agents toward susceptible-rich destinations raises transmission risk, a contagion externality the planner internalizes by restricting such flows. Second, the migration of infected agents toward better-resourced cities relieves hospital congestion at the epicenter, a congestion externality the planner internalizes by encouraging such flows. The two externalities work in opposite directions, and our comparative statics show when each dominates. The framework explains a cross-country pattern that standard misallocation theory cannot: during COVID-19, countries with greater regional dispersion in mortality tended to have lower aggregate mortality. This pattern arises naturally once contagion and endogenous mobility are added to a standard misallocation framework. More broadly, the analysis identifies a setting in which spatial dispersion can raise rather than reduce welfare, reversing the sign of the standard misallocation prescription.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了疫情期间个体迁移决策如何与医院资源的空间配置相互作用，并以闭式解形式刻画了自由放任均衡与规划者配置。易感个体离开高感染城市，而感染者则向资源更优的城市移动，但这些私人决策在两个方面与规划者的选择产生分歧。首先，感染者向易感人群密集目的地的迁移增加了传播风险，这是一种传染外部性，规划者通过限制此类流动将其内部化。其次，感染者向资源更优城市的迁移缓解了疫情中心的医院拥挤状况，这是一种拥挤外部性，规划者通过鼓励此类流动将其内部化。这两种外部性作用方向相反，我们的比较静态分析揭示了各自占优的条件。该框架解释了一种标准错配理论无法解释的跨国模式：在COVID-19期间，区域死亡率离散度较大的国家往往具有较低的总体死亡率。一旦将传染性和内生流动性纳入标准错配框架，这一模式便自然显现。更广泛而言，分析识别了一种情境，其中空间分散能够提高而非降低福利，从而逆转了标准错配处方的符号。

title: Non-monetary incentives and bureaucratic performance: Evidence from U.S. courts
title_zh: 非货币激励与官僚绩效：来自美国法院的证据
title_primary: 非货币激励与官僚绩效：来自美国法院的证据
title_secondary: Non-monetary incentives and bureaucratic performance: Evidence from U.S. courts
authors: Jonathan B. Petkun
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-13 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Federal judges—who enjoy lifetime tenure and constitutionally protected salaries—represent an especially hard test case for incentive-based bureaucratic reform. I study the “six-month list,” a reform requiring U.S. federal courts to publicly identify judges with overdue matters. Using a regression discontinuity design and other methods, I find that matters most exposed are resolved approximately 14% faster than those least exposed, with larger effects among younger, non-white, and female judges. The speed gains come with trade-offs: upfront time savings are partially offset by downstream delays, and more-exposed matters are more likely to be reversed on appeal. A bunching analysis estimates aggregate time savings of approximately 4%, demonstrating that non-monetary levers can shift behavior even among highly insulated elite professionals.
abstract_zh: 联邦法官——享有终身任期及宪法保障的薪酬——构成了基于激励的官僚改革中尤为严峻的考验案例。我研究了“六个月清单”这一改革，该改革要求美国联邦法院公开识别存在逾期未决案件的法官。利用断点回归设计及其他方法，我发现，暴露程度最高的案件比暴露程度最低的案件解决速度快约14%，且在较年轻、非白人及女性法官中效果更为显著。速度提升伴随权衡：前期时间节省部分被后续延误所抵消，且暴露程度更高的案件更有可能在上诉中被推翻。通过聚束分析估计，总体时间节省约为4%，这表明即使在高度隔离的精英专业人士中，非货币杠杆也能改变行为。

title: The Sound We Haven’t Heard Before: A Commentary on “Fighting Fire with Fire: Infusing AI into Peer Review to Sustain Quality Scholarship”
title_zh: 我们未曾听过的声音：评“以火攻火：将人工智能融入同行评审以维持学术质量
title_primary: 我们未曾听过的声音：评“以火攻火：将人工智能融入同行评审以维持学术质量
title_secondary: The Sound We Haven’t Heard Before: A Commentary on “Fighting Fire with Fire: Infusing AI into Peer Review to Sustain Quality Scholarship”
authors: Tinglong Dai
abstract: This commentary responds to “Fighting Fire with Fire: Infusing AI into Peer Review to Sustain Quality Scholarship” [Bhargava HK, Bana S, Zhang Z, Brandimarte L, Choudary V, Li F, Loupos P, Zantedeschi D (2026) Fighting fire with fire: Infusing AI into peer review to sustain quality scholarship. Management Sci. Forthcoming.]. It shares the paper’s core position, that journals should govern artificial intelligence openly rather than leave it to the shadows, but it questions the premise that rising submission volume poses an existential threat. The safeguard is human judgment. Our shared fatigue with derivative, repetitive work is a sensor more discerning than any AI detector, because a model trained on what we have already rewarded cannot produce the novelty that our community prizes. The threat to a journal like Management Science is thus more contained than the original alarm implies, provided AI remains a non-final input and humans retain ownership of novelty and contribution. One test should govern any AI workflow: does it ask more of human judgment, or less? This commentary was accepted by Christoph Loch.
abstract_zh: 本评论回应了“以火攻火：将人工智能注入同行评审以维持高质量学术”一文[Bhargava HK, Bana S, Zhang Z, Brandimarte L, Choudary V, Li F, Loupos P, Zantedeschi D (2026) 以火攻火：将人工智能注入同行评审以维持高质量学术。《管理科学》即将出版]。本文赞同该文的核心立场，即期刊应公开治理人工智能，而非任其在暗处运作，但对其关于投稿量上升构成生存威胁的前提提出质疑。保障在于人类判断力。我们对重复性、衍生性工作的共同倦怠，是一种比任何人工智能检测器都更敏锐的传感器，因为基于我们已奖励内容训练的模型无法产生我们学术界所珍视的新颖性。因此，对《管理科学》这类期刊的威胁比原文所暗示的更为有限，前提是人工智能仍作为非最终输入，而人类保留对新颖性和贡献的所有权。任何人工智能工作流程都应遵循一项检验标准：它是对人类判断力的要求更高，还是更低？本评论由克里斯托夫·洛赫接受。

title: How You Pay Drives What You Choose: Mental Accounting in Health Insurance Plan Choice
title_zh: 支付方式如何影响选择：健康保险计划选择中的心理账户
title_primary: 支付方式如何影响选择：健康保险计划选择中的心理账户
title_secondary: How You Pay Drives What You Choose: Mental Accounting in Health Insurance Plan Choice
authors: Jonathan Gruber, Mengyun Lin, Haoming Liu, Junjian Yi
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-31 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We document that the source of funds for paying health insurance premiums has a dramatic impact on plan choices. We focus on the MediSave program in Singapore, a medical savings account that is used to pay out-of-pocket medical spending. Residents can also pay their health insurance premiums with cash or MediSave funds, but are subject to limits that vary by age and over time. By exploiting variations in those limits, we consistently find that when individuals are able to pay their health insurance premiums with MediSave funds, they are less price sensitive and more willing to enroll in more generous plans. We develop and estimate a mental accounting model which explains these patterns. We embed and reject alternative explanations such as hassle costs and liquidity constraints. We then extend this model and show that mental accounting can explain much, but not all, of the misweighting of premiums relative to out-of-pocket expenses in health insurance choice. We also find that allowing MediSave payment for both premiums and out-of-pocket expenses (e.g. putting them in the same mental account) enhances individual welfare and reduces adverse selection.
abstract_zh: 我们记录了支付健康保险保费的资金来源对计划选择产生显著影响。我们聚焦于新加坡的MediSave计划，这是一个用于支付自费医疗支出的医疗储蓄账户。居民也可以用现金或MediSave资金支付健康保险保费，但受到随年龄和时间变化的限额约束。

title: DP20178 Cryptocurrencies and decentralised finance: functions and financial stability implications
title_zh: 加密货币与去中心化金融：功能及对金融稳定的影响
title_primary: 加密货币与去中心化金融：功能及对金融稳定的影响
title_secondary: DP20178 Cryptocurrencies and decentralised finance: functions and financial stability implications
authors: Matteo Aquilina, Giulio Cornelli, Jon Frost, Leonardo Gambacorta
official: 官方在线 2025-04-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Cryptocurrencies and decentralised finance (DeFi) aim to replicate many of the economic functions of traditional finance (TradFi), but their distinctive features introduce new financial stability risks. We analyse these features, and examine key developments, such as smart contracts, decentralised exchanges (DEXs), stablecoins and new forms of central bank money. Our findings suggest that while the underlying economic drivers are not different than in TradFi, DeFi poses significant challenges, including new forms of information asymmetries, market inefficiencies and the risk of cryptoisation in emerging markets. We propose tailored regulatory interventions, such as embedding rules within smart contracts and strengthening the oversight of stablecoins, to manage financial stability risks. Finally, we provide a framework for prudential regulation that can mitigate risks while fostering innovation in the rapidly evolving crypto ecosystem.
abstract_zh: 加密货币与去中心化金融（DeFi）旨在复制传统金融（TradFi）的诸多经济功能，但其独特特征引入了新的金融稳定风险。我们分析了这些特征，并考察了智能合约、去中心化交易所（DEXs）、稳定币以及新型央行货币等关键发展。研究结果表明，尽管底层经济驱动因素与传统金融并无差异，但DeFi带来了显著挑战，包括新型信息不对称、市场低效以及新兴市场中的加密化风险。我们提出针对性监管干预措施，例如将规则嵌入智能合约并加强对稳定币的监督，以管理金融稳定风险。最后，我们构建了一个审慎监管框架，可在快速演变的加密生态系统中降低风险的同时促进创新。

title: Political Accountability During Crises: Evidence From 40 Years of Financial Policies
title_zh: 危机时期的政治问责：来自40年金融政策的证据
title_primary: 危机时期的政治问责：来自40年金融政策的证据
title_secondary: Political Accountability During Crises: Evidence From 40 Years of Financial Policies
authors: Orkun Saka, Yuemei Ji, Clement Minaudier
abstract: We show that politicians facing a binding term limit are more likely to engage in financial deliberalization than those facing reelection, but only in the wake of a financial crisis. In particular, they implement policies that tend to favor incumbent financial institutions over the general population, such as increasing barriers to entry in the banking sector. We propose a conceptual framework and several mechanisms to rationalize this behavior and show that revolving doors between the government and the financial sector play a key role in encouraging bank‐friendly policies after crises.
abstract_zh: 我们表明，面临任期限制的政客比面临连任的政客更有可能实施金融去自由化，但仅在金融危机之后如此。具体而言，他们倾向于实施有利于现有金融机构而非普通民众的政策，例如提高银行业准入门槛。我们提出了一个概念框架和若干机制来解释这一行为，并表明政府与金融部门之间的旋转门在危机后鼓励亲银行政策方面发挥了关键作用。

title: Quantile Effects in Discrete Choice with Social Interactions
title_zh: 社会互动下离散选择的分位数效应
title_primary: 社会互动下离散选择的分位数效应
title_secondary: Quantile Effects in Discrete Choice with Social Interactions
authors: Zhongjian Lin
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper provides a method to study quantile effects in discrete choice with social interactions. The method is based on a behavioral social interactions model from quantile preference in decision making and demonstrates peer effects on different quantiles of discrete outcomes. The peer effects parameters are estimated by a nested pseudoscore (NPS) approach, which is developed to tackle the computational burden pertaining to the social interactions model. Consistency and asymptotic normality are established for the proposed NPS estimator. We illustrate the finite sample performance of the model and the estimator by Monte Carlo experiments and an application of peer effects among students on exercise decisions, using the National Longitudinal Study of Adolescent Health dataset.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种研究存在社会互动时离散选择中分位数效应的方法。该方法基于决策过程中分位数偏好的行为社会互动模型，揭示了同伴效应对离散结果不同分位数的影响。为应对社会互动模型带来的计算负担，我们开发了嵌套伪得分（NPS）方法对同伴效应参数进行估计，并建立了该NPS估计量的一致性和渐近正态性。通过蒙特卡洛实验以及基于美国青少年健康纵向研究数据集的学生运动决策中同伴效应的应用分析，我们验证了模型与估计量的有限样本表现。

title: Climate fairness, economic development, and Europe’s responsibility
title_zh: 气候公平、经济发展与欧洲的责任
title_primary: 气候公平、经济发展与欧洲的责任
title_secondary: Climate fairness, economic development, and Europe’s responsibility
authors: Galina Hale, Michael Halling, Nora Paulus, Han Pham
abstract: The idea of equal cumulative emissions per person is simple: every individual should have an equal claim on the atmosphere regardless of where they live. Using historical population and emissions data from 1870 onward, this column examines how the world’s remaining carbon budget could be allocated fairly across countries. European states have already consumed more than their share, whereas many developing countries retain positive claims. Allocating the remaining budget fairly can be compatible with development goals if developing countries can access cleaner technologies. Europe can start by redesigning the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism to embed explicit fairness principles.
abstract_zh: 人均累计排放量平等的理念简洁明了：无论居住何地，每个人都应平等享有对大气资源的权利。本文基于1870年以来的历史人口与排放数据，探讨如何在全球剩余碳预算中实现国家间的公平分配。欧洲国家已超额消耗其份额，而众多发展中国家仍保有正向权益。若发展中国家能够获取清洁技术，公平分配剩余碳预算可与可持续发展目标兼容。欧洲可率先改革碳边境调节机制，将明确的公平原则嵌入其中。

title: The Capital-Access Premium and the Won: Korean Stablecoin Premia as a Leading Indicator of Exchange-Rate Pressure
title_zh: 资本获取溢价与韩元：韩国稳定币溢价作为汇率压力的先行指标
title_primary: 资本获取溢价与韩元：韩国稳定币溢价作为汇率压力的先行指标
title_secondary: The Capital-Access Premium and the Won: Korean Stablecoin Premia as a Leading Indicator of Exchange-Rate Pressure
authors: Jewon Yoo
abstract: On Korean cryptocurrency exchanges, dollar-pegged stablecoins trade above their dollar value at the market exchange rate. In the primary USDT/KRW sample used in this paper, the average premium is 1.96%. Because stablecoins are designed to maintain a one-dollar value, their won premium offers a direct market measure of dollar-access pressure under segmented crypto-FX markets. Using 919 daily observations from 7 December 2023 to 12 June 2026, we show that the premium co-moves closely with the Bitcoin kimchi premium and predicts won depreciation over the next one to three days. The relation survives controls for realized USD/KRW volatility, VIX, dollar strength, and domestic equity-market conditions. Coefficients are larger in high-VIX and high-FX-volatility regimes, but the short sample calls for caution. Stablecoin premia may provide a timely gauge of exchange-rate pressure in segmented markets.
abstract_zh: 在韩国加密货币交易所，与美元挂钩的稳定币以高于市场汇率下美元价值的价格进行交易。本文使用的主要USDT/KRW样本中，平均溢价为1.96%。由于稳定币旨在维持一美元的价值，其韩元溢价为在加密与外汇市场分割条件下美元获取压力提供了直接的市场衡量指标。利用2023年12月7日至2026年6月12日期间的919个日度观测值，我们表明该溢价与比特币泡菜溢价紧密联动，并能预测未来一至三天内韩元的贬值趋势。这一关系在控制已实现的USD/KRW波动率、VIX指数、美元强度及国内股市状况后依然成立。在高VIX和高外汇波动率环境下，系数更大，但样本期较短需谨慎解读。稳定币溢价可能为分割市场中的汇率压力提供及时的风向标。

title: Bank FinTech and Risk Inefficiency in China's Banking Industry
title_zh: 中国银行业金融科技与风险低效率
title_primary: 中国银行业金融科技与风险低效率
title_secondary: Bank FinTech and Risk Inefficiency in China's Banking Industry
authors: Maoyong Cheng, Yang Qu, Pin Guo
abstract: This paper examines the effects of bank FinTech on credit risk inefficiency using data for Chinese commercial banks from 2008 to 2017. We first construct a bank FinTech index with the help of web crawler technology and the data mining theory. Then, we examine the effects of bank FinTech on credit risk inefficiency. The results show that the development of bank FinTech significantly reduces credit risk inefficiency. Further, we explore the indirect effects and find that bank FinTech increases non‐interest business and thus reduces credit risk inefficiency. Finally, we find that the beneficial effects of bank FinTech on credit risk inefficiency are weaker for listed banks and state‐owned banks.
abstract_zh: 本文利用2008—2017年中国商业银行数据，考察银行金融科技对信贷风险非效率的影响。首先，借助网络爬虫技术和数据挖掘理论构建银行金融科技指数；其次，检验银行金融科技对信贷风险非效率的作用。结果表明，银行金融科技的发展显著降低了信贷风险非效率。进一步探究间接效应发现，银行金融科技通过增加非利息业务从而降低信贷风险非效率。最后，研究发现银行金融科技对信贷风险非效率的积极效应在上市银行和国有银行中较弱。

title: 减税激励与外资稳定：预提税改革的证据
title_zh: 减税激励与外资稳定：预提税改革的证据
title_primary: 减税激励与外资稳定：预提税改革的证据
authors: 周小昶, 冯晨, 曾艺
official: 官方发布 2026-07-05 · 来源：CNKI RSS
abstract: 外商投资是推进高水平对外开放的重要内容，为发展新质生产力和实现中国式现代化发挥着重要作用。国际招商引资已进入存量博弈时代，为了鼓励境外投资者持续扩大在华投资，中国于2017年对非居民企业施行以分配利润再投资缓征预提所得税的优惠政策。本文发现，再投资税收优惠对面临资金约束的外资企业的投资规模具有显著的改善效果。机制分析表明，该政策能够扩大股权融资、降低权益资本成本，有助于缓解融资约束，进而促进投资。进一步地，本文发现该政策的作用效果在境外投资者预提税率较高、持股比例较高、外资企业的避税程度较低或所在地营商环境较好的情况下更加明显。同时，再投资税收优惠提升了外资企业经营绩效和市场价值，并对集团中其他子公司的投资产生正向溢出效应。本文的研究不仅为理解稳外资税收激励政策的成效和作用路径提供了经验支持，而且为优化吸引和利用外资的税收政策环境提供了有益参考。
abstract_zh: 外商投资是推进高水平对外开放的重要内容，为发展新质生产力和实现中国式现代化发挥着重要作用。国际招商引资已进入存量博弈时代，为了鼓励境外投资者持续扩大在华投资，中国于2017年对非居民企业施行以分配利润再投资缓征预提所得税的优惠政策。本文发现，再投资税收优惠对面临资金约束的外资企业的投资规模具有显著的改善效果。机制分析表明，该政策能够扩大股权融资、降低权益资本成本，有助于缓解融资约束，进而促进投资。...

title: Identifying Peer Effects in Networks with Unobserved Effort and Isolated Students
title_zh: 识别未观测努力与孤立学生网络中的同伴效应
title_primary: 识别未观测努力与孤立学生网络中的同伴效应
title_secondary: Identifying Peer Effects in Networks with Unobserved Effort and Isolated Students
authors: Aristide Houndetoungan, Cristelle Kouame, Michael Vlassopoulos
abstract: Peer influence on effort devoted to some activity is often studied when effort is unobserved, and the researcher instead observes an outcome that combines effort with other shocks. For instance, in education, achievement measures such as GPA reflect both effort and idiosyncratic GPA shocks. We propose an alternative approach that circumvents this approximation. Our framework distinguishes unobserved shocks to GPA that do not affect effort from preference shocks that do affect effort levels. We show that peer effects estimates obtained using our approach can differ significantly from classical estimates (where effort is approximated) if the network includes isolated students. Applying our approach to data on high school students in the United States, we find that peer effect estimates relying on GPA as a proxy for effort are 40% lower than those obtained using our approach.
abstract_zh: 摘要 当努力程度不可观测，而研究者仅能观察到结合了努力与其他冲击的最终结果时，关于同伴效应对某项活动投入程度的影响研究往往面临挑战。例如在教育领域，GPA等学业成就指标既反映努力程度，也包含个体特有的GPA冲击。本文提出一种规避此类近似处理的新方法。我们的分析框架将不影响努力程度的不可观测GPA冲击与确实影响努力水平的偏好冲击进行区分。研究表明，当社交网络中存在孤立学生时，采用本方法获得的同伴效应估计值可能与经典方法（将努力程度近似处理）存在显著差异。通过将本方法应用于美国高中生数据，我们发现，以GPA作为努力程度代理变量的同伴效应估计值，比采用本方法获得的估计值低40%。

title: Filters in abstract aggregation with infinite sequences of signals
title_zh: 无限信号序列下抽象聚合中的滤波器
title_primary: 无限信号序列下抽象聚合中的滤波器
title_secondary: Filters in abstract aggregation with infinite sequences of signals
authors: Susumu Cato, Stéphane Gonzalez, Eric Rémila, Philippe Solal
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-25 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study proposes a general framework for aggregation problems, in which agents’ signals given in an infinite sequence are aggregated. Notably, no restriction is imposed on the set of signals; hence, this framework is applicable to any type of attributes, including preferences, ballots, pieces of information, or judgments. The result can include the empty set that corresponds to the silence of the aggregation rule. Our main focus is to analyze the process by which the structure of the family of decisive coalitions forms a filter or an ultrafilter. In our framework, a coalition is regarded as decisive if a signal is socially approved as long as every agent in the coalition picks the signal up unanimously. First, we show that the family of decisive coalitions forms a filter under a certain axiom representing a stability condition. Next, in the case where the set of signals is finite, we provide axiomatic characterizations of the class of agreement-based rules associated with filters or ultrafilters: a signal is approved if and only if it is a unanimous agreement of some coalition in a specified filter or ultrafilter. Our axiomatic results demonstrate the robustness and stability of such rules.
abstract_zh: 本研究提出一个通用的聚合问题框架，其中代理人在无限序列中给出的信号被聚合。值得注意的是，对信号集合未施加任何限制；因此，该框架适用于任何类型的属性，包括偏好、选票、信息片段或判断。结果可以包括空集，这对应于聚合规则的沉默。我们的主要焦点是分析决定性联盟家族的结构如何形成滤子或超滤子的过程。在我们的框架中，如果一个信号只要联盟中的每个代理一致选择该信号，该信号就被社会认可，则该联盟被视为决定性的。首先，我们证明在代表稳定性条件的特定公理下，决定性联盟家族形成一个滤子。其次，在信号集合有限的情况下，我们提供了与滤子或超滤子相关联的基于一致同意的规则类的公理化特征：一个信号被认可当且仅当它是指定滤子或超滤子中某个联盟的一致同意。我们的公理化结果展示了此类规则的稳健性和稳定性。

title: Labor Market Institutions, Fiscal Multipliers, and Macroeconomic Volatility
title_zh: 劳动力市场制度、财政乘数与宏观经济波动
title_primary: 劳动力市场制度、财政乘数与宏观经济波动
title_secondary: Labor Market Institutions, Fiscal Multipliers, and Macroeconomic Volatility
authors: Maximilian Boeck, Jesús Crespo Cuaresma, Christian Glocker
abstract: How do labor market institutions shape the transmission of government spending shocks and macroeconomic volatility? We develop a theoretical model in which labor market institutions affect fiscal transmission through their effect on wage rigidity, job separation, and matching frictions. We estimate an interacted panel vector autoregressive model for 16 OECD economies and study how macroeconomic responses to government spending shocks vary with institutional labor market characteristics. In line with our theoretical predictions, we show that institutions that stabilize employment and wages tend to reduce output volatility and attenuate the response of output and employment to government spending shocks.
abstract_zh: 劳动力市场制度如何影响政府支出冲击的传导机制及宏观经济波动？我们构建了一个理论模型，其中劳动力市场制度通过影响工资刚性、岗位分离和匹配摩擦来作用于财政传导机制。基于16个OECD经济体的交互面板向量自回归模型估计，我们研究了宏观经济对政府支出冲击的反应如何随劳动力市场制度特征而变化。与理论预测一致，我们发现稳定就业和工资的制度倾向于降低产出波动，并削弱产出和就业对政府支出冲击的反应。

title: Unpacking spatially explicit cropland non-agriculturalization in China based on satellite remote sensing data: A 30-year analysis of spatial patterns and conversion types
title_zh: 基于卫星遥感数据的中国耕地非农化空间显式解析：30年空间格局与转换类型分析
title_primary: 基于卫星遥感数据的中国耕地非农化空间显式解析：30年空间格局与转换类型分析
title_secondary: Unpacking spatially explicit cropland non-agriculturalization in China based on satellite remote sensing data: A 30-year analysis of spatial patterns and conversion types
authors: Desheng Jiang, Zhuojian Wen, Yuqi Zhong, Yuecheng Li, Guilin Liu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-15 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Cropland non-agriculturalization, encompassing permanent loss and transitions to non-grain uses, drives global food insecurity. However, accurately mapping these diverse pathways across large spatiotemporal scales remains methodologically elusive. To address this, we developed a novel approach integrating multi-index temporal-spectral segmentation (LandTrendr) with Random Forest (RF) classification to map three primary cropland conversion types in China (1991–2020): conversion to non-grain uses, waterbody, and built-up land. Crucially, to explicitly overcome phenological confounding effects, we innovatively utilized the Coefficient of Variation (CV) of vegetation indices to suppress seasonal noise and extract robust inter-annual cultivation features. By employing the LandTrendr algorithm to segment these CV metrics and other multi-spectral indices, we detected the features of distinct disturbances, which subsequently served as predictors within an RF framework to map the different cropland non-agriculturalization types. This methodology yielded an 87.5 ± 1.0% overall accuracy. China's non-agriculturalized cropland reached 426,388 km2, comprising conversions to non-grain (312,771 km2), built-up (92,462 km2), and waterbody (21,155 km2). Spatially, non-grain conversions concentrated in the Northeast China Plain and northern arid/semi-arid regions. Waterbody transitions aggregated in the Middle and Lower Yangtze Plain, while built-up land expansion dominated major coastal and urban agglomerations (Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze/Pearl River Deltas). Temporally, non-grain transitions exhibited early fluctuating upward trajectories, whereas waterbody and built-up conversions peaked in 2001 and 2013, respectively. Ultimately, this research establishes a robust multi-index framework capable of untangling concurrent cropland non-agriculturalization types over vast extents. By accurately attributing spatially explicit transitions, our methodology offers a reliable mechanism for continuous monitoring and a strong empirical basis for global sustainable agricultural policies.
abstract_zh: 耕地非农化，涵盖永久性丧失及向非粮用途的转变，威胁着全球粮食安全。然而，在广阔时空尺度上精确绘制这些多样化的转变路径，在方法论上仍具挑战性。为此，我们开发了一种新方法，整合多指数时间-光谱分割（LandTrendr）与随机森林（RF）分类，以绘制中国1991-2020年间三种主要耕地转化类型：非粮化、水域化和建设用地化。关键创新在于，为明确克服物候混淆效应，我们创新性地利用植被指数变异系数（CV）抑制季节性噪声，提取稳健的年内耕作特征。通过应用LandTrendr算法分割这些CV指标及其他多光谱指数，我们检测了不同干扰的特征，这些特征随后作为RF框架内的预测因子，用于绘制不同耕地非农化类型图。该方法总体精度达到87.5±1.0%。中国非农化耕地面积达426,388平方公里，包括非粮化（312,771平方公里）、建设用地化（92,462平方公里）和水域化（21,155平方公里）。空间上，非粮化转变集中于东北平原及北方干旱/半干旱地区。水域化转变聚集于长江中下游平原，而建设用地扩张主导了主要沿海及城市群（京津冀、长三角、珠三角）。时间上，非粮化转变呈现早期波动上升趋势，而水域化和建设用地化转变分别于2001年和2013年达到峰值。最终，本研究建立了一个稳健的多指数框架，能够在大范围内解析并存的耕地非农化类型。通过精确归因空间显式转变，我们的方法为持续监测提供了可靠机制，并为全球可持续农业政策提供了坚实的实证基础。

title: Continuity of the Distribution Function of the argmax of a Gaussian Process
title_zh: 高斯过程最大值点分布函数的连续性
title_primary: 高斯过程最大值点分布函数的连续性
title_secondary: Continuity of the Distribution Function of the argmax of a Gaussian Process
authors: Matias D. Cattaneo, Gregory F. Cox, Michael Jansson, Kenichi Nagasawa
abstract: Certain extremum estimators have asymptotic distributions that are non‐Gaussian, yet characterizable as the distribution of the arg max of a Gaussian process. This paper presents high‐level sufficient conditions under which such asymptotic distributions admit a continuous distribution function. The plausibility of the sufficient conditions is demonstrated by verifying them in three examples, namely, maximum score estimation, empirical risk minimization, and threshold regression estimation. In turn, the continuity result buttresses several recently proposed inference procedures whose validity seems to require a result of the kind established herein. A notable feature of the high‐level assumptions is that one of them is designed to enable us to employ the Cameron–Martin theorem. In a leading special case, the assumption in question is demonstrably weak and appears to be close to minimal.
abstract_zh: 某些极值估计量的渐近分布并非高斯分布，但可表征为高斯过程最大值参数的分布。本文提出了高阶充分条件，在这些条件下，此类渐近分布具有连续分布函数。通过三个实例——最大得分估计、经验风险最小化和阈值回归估计——验证了这些充分条件的可行性。连续性结果进而支持了几种近期提出的推断方法，这些方法的有效性似乎依赖于本文所确立的这类结果。高阶假设的一个显著特点是，其中一项旨在使我们能够运用Cameron–Martin定理。在一个主要特例中，该假设被证明是弱的，且接近最小化。

title: State-dependent within-artist anchor reversal in ultra-contemporary art auctions
title_zh: 超当代艺术拍卖中艺术家内部锚定反转的状态依赖性
title_primary: 超当代艺术拍卖中艺术家内部锚定反转的状态依赖性
title_secondary: State-dependent within-artist anchor reversal in ultra-contemporary art auctions
authors: Ziwen Chen
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In a panel of 4259 ultra-contemporary auction lots (39 artists, 130 houses, 2005Q4–2026Q1), |log(hammer/high estimate)| compresses with within-artist rank only for artists with above-median dispersion in their first five lots (TWFE β = −0.293, wild cluster bootstrap p = 0.015). Of 19 such imprecise-start artists, 18 begin above estimate (Fisher exact p = 0.0008 vs the empirical sample marginal). The compression is not a floor effect: a precise-start subgroup with mean |gap| = 0.456 — well above the imprecise group's terminal level — shows no convergence (β = −0.025, p = 0.883). The compression operates on hammer prices, not on specialist estimate widths.
abstract_zh: 在包含4259件超当代艺术拍卖标的（39位艺术家，130家拍卖行，2005年第四季度至2026年第一季度）的面板数据中，|log(成交价/高估价)|仅对艺术家内部排名呈现压缩效应，且仅限于前五件拍品分散度高于中位数的艺术家（TWFE β = −0.293，野生聚类自助法p = 0.015）。在19位此类起始不精确的艺术家中，有18位起初高于估价（Fisher精确检验p = 0.0008，对比经验样本边际）。该压缩并非地板效应：起始精确的子组平均|差距|为0.456——远高于不精确组的最终水平——却未显示收敛（β = −0.025，p = 0.883）。压缩作用于成交价，而非专家估价宽度。

title: Inflated Recommendations
title_zh: 膨胀的推荐
title_primary: 膨胀的推荐
title_secondary: Inflated Recommendations
authors: Martin Peitz, Anton Sobolev
abstract: Biased recommendations arise naturally in markets with heterogeneous consumers. We study a model in which a monopolist offers an experience good to a population of consumers with heterogeneous tastes and makes personalized purchase recommendations. We provide conditions under which a firm makes welfare-reducing purchase recommendations with positive probability, resulting in inflated recommendations. We extend this insight to a setting in which an intermediary makes the recommendations, whereas a seller sets the retail price. Regulatory interventions that forbid inflated recommendations may lead to higher social welfare or may backfire.
abstract_zh: 在消费者偏好异质的市场中，偏见性推荐自然产生。我们研究了一个模型，其中垄断者向具有异质品味的消费者群体提供体验品，并做出个性化购买推荐。我们给出了企业在正概率下做出降低福利的购买推荐的条件，导致推荐膨胀。我们将这一见解扩展到中介机构做出推荐、而卖家设定零售价格的情境。禁止膨胀推荐的监管干预可能提高社会福利，也可能适得其反。

title: Individualism and working from home
title_zh: 个人主义与居家办公
title_primary: 个人主义与居家办公
title_secondary: Individualism and working from home
authors: Jan Bietenbeck, Natalie Irmert, Therese Nilsson
abstract: We show that culturally transmitted individualism is an important determinant of working from home (WFH). Using individual-level data from the U.S. Current Population Survey (CPS) and the European Social Survey (ESS), we compare immigrants and their descendants from different cultural backgrounds residing in the same location. A 10-point increase in country-of-origin individualism (0–100 scale) increases the likelihood of WFH by 3.9 percentage points and WFH hours by 1.12 per week in the CPS, and frequent WFH by 2 percentage points in the ESS. Individualism appears to affect WFH partly through higher educational attainment and occupational selection.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，文化传承的个人主义是居家办公（WFH）的一个重要决定因素。利用美国当前人口调查（CPS）和欧洲社会调查（ESS）的个体层面数据，我们比较了居住在同一地区的不同文化背景的移民及其后代。在原籍国个人主义指数（0-100分制）上每增加10分，CPS中居家办公的可能性提高3.9个百分点，每周居家办公小时数增加1.12小时；在ESS中，频繁居家办公的比例提高2个百分点。个人主义似乎部分通过更高的教育成就和职业选择影响居家办公。

title: Applying the contingent behavior method at the regional level: Evidence from forest recreation

title: Robust Factor Analysis for High-Dimensional Data with Outliers
title_primary: Robust Factor Analysis for High-Dimensional Data with Outliers
authors: Pengbiao Zhou, Jialiang Li, Xiao Guo
abstract: Outliers are commonly encountered in financial and economic data, and pose significant challenges to the study of the conventional factor models. This article focuses on factor analysis for high-dimensional data in the presence of random outliers. We first propose a new class of factor model which incorporates a sparse outlier matrix. We then develop a class of robust methods to estimate the factor matrix and the number of factors. Under mild conditions, consistency of the proposed estimators is established. Judging from the numerical examples, we observe that the proposed estimation methods outperform existing approaches. Our methods significantly enhance the performance of the high-dimensional factor analysis when the data are contaminated by outliers.

title: Duplicated Orders, Swift Cancellations, and Fast Market Making in Fragmented Markets

title: Entry‐Encouraging Vertical Integration
title_zh: 鼓励纵向一体化的进入
title_primary: 鼓励纵向一体化的进入
title_secondary: Entry‐Encouraging Vertical Integration
authors: Ramon Fauli‐Oller, Joel Sandonís
abstract: ABSTRACT It is well established that a vertically integrated firm may have an incentive to raise its rivals' costs by increasing the wholesale price of inputs. We show that this incentive can lead vertical integration to facilitate entry into the downstream market: higher input costs weaken incumbent rivals, thereby improving the entrant's competitive position. Our framework considers an upstream firm that offers observable two‐part tariff contracts to downstream firms. The downstream market consists of two incumbents and one potential entrant, with competition modeled à la Cournot. In addition, downstream firms may also source inputs from an alternative, less efficient supplier. We fully characterize the conditions under which entry‐encouraging vertical integration is profitable and arises in equilibrium, and demonstrate that in most cases it enhances overall welfare. By contrast, we also identify a (small) region where vertical integration reduces the entrant's profits and deters entry. In such cases, vertical integration is always detrimental to welfare.
abstract_zh: 摘要 众所周知，垂直一体化企业可能通过提高投入品的批发价格来增加竞争对手的成本。我们证明，这种激励可能导致垂直一体化促进下游市场的进入：更高的投入成本削弱了现有竞争对手，从而改善了进入者的竞争地位。我们的框架考虑一个上游企业向下游企业提供可观察的两部分 tariff 合同。下游市场由两家现有企业和一家潜在进入者组成，竞争以古诺（Cournot）模式进行。此外，下游企业也可能从替代性但效率较低的供应商处获取投入品。我们全面刻画了鼓励进入的垂直一体化在何种条件下有利可图并在均衡中出现，并证明在大多数情况下，这种一体化提升了整体福利。相反，我们也识别出一个（较小的）区域，其中垂直一体化降低了进入者的利润并阻碍了进入。在这种情况下，垂直一体化总是对福利有害。

title: The impact of extreme climate events on U.S. corn markets
title_zh: 极端气候事件对美国玉米市场的影响
title_primary: 极端气候事件对美国玉米市场的影响
title_secondary: The impact of extreme climate events on U.S. corn markets
authors: Raghav Goyal
abstract: This study examines the effect of extreme weather events on corn market returns for the top 10 corn-producing states from 2005 to 2024. Using an event study method, we examine 1,726 extreme weather events (droughts, heatwaves, floods, severe storms, fire events, and precipitation extremes) and estimate their impact on cumulative abnormal returns (CARs) in corn markets. About 32.5% of events produce statistically significant CARs, with the largest impacts from storms, and droughts. The market response is not instantaneous but accumulates over time – peaking between days 8 and 10 following the event. Moreover, we identify significant heterogeneity across event categories, seasons, and geographic regions, with larger impacts during planting and harvesting seasons. Our analysis confirms the significant effects of lagged CARs, USDA announcements, and general market volatility on abnormal returns following these extreme events. Our results are important for designing effective adaptation policy, risk management, and driving efficiency through the supply chain.

title: Bringing the elderly into the digital age: the impact of the “Broadband China” policy
title_zh: 将老年人带入数字时代：“宽带中国”政策的影响
title_primary: 将老年人带入数字时代：“宽带中国”政策的影响
title_secondary: Bringing the elderly into the digital age: the impact of the “Broadband China” policy
authors: Zhengcheng Peng, Qinghong He, Han Xiao
abstract: The digital divide among the elderly represents a classic problem; however, previous research has primarily focused on the digital access divide resulting from the characteristics of the consumers. According to the tenets of digital poverty theory, this study employs a counterfactual experiment, specifically the ‘Broadband China’ policy, to assess the impact of internet infrastructure provision on reducing the digital access divide among the elderly. The policy has increased the probability of the elderly using the internet by an average of 35.7% and the intensity of internet use by 54.4%. It significantly increases the likelihood of household broadband access, exerting an influence on the elderly’s increased internet utilization through the provision of internet infrastructure. It diminishes monthly household information consumption expenditure by approximately 12.1%, exerting a price influence on the increased internet utilization by the elderly. This study enhances our understanding of the economic supply-side factors that contribute to the digital divide among the elderly. To mitigate the digital divide among the elderly, implementing digital poverty alleviation measures concurrently across multiple dimensions is imperative, including internet infrastructure accessibility and the affordability of online services.
abstract_zh: 老年人数字鸿沟是一个经典问题，然而以往研究主要聚焦于消费者特征导致的数字接入鸿沟。依据数字贫困理论，本研究采用反事实实验，即“宽带中国”政策，评估互联网基础设施供给对缩小老年人数字接入鸿沟的影响。该政策使老年人使用互联网的概率平均提高了35.7%，互联网使用强度提高了54.4%。它显著增加了家庭宽带接入的可能性，通过提供互联网基础设施对老年人互联网使用增加产生影响。它使家庭月信息消费支出减少了约12.1%，对老年人互联网使用增加产生了价格影响。本研究增进了我们对导致老年人数字鸿沟的经济供给侧因素的理解。为缓解老年人数字鸿沟，需在多个维度同时实施数字扶贫措施，包括互联网基础设施的可及性和在线服务的可负担性。

title: Can China’s live hog futures market respond to the government-released hog product reports?
title_zh: 中国生猪期货市场能否对政府发布的生猪产品报告做出反应？
title_primary: 中国生猪期货市场能否对政府发布的生猪产品报告做出反应？
title_secondary: Can China’s live hog futures market respond to the government-released hog product reports?
authors: Mengying Liang, Tao Xiong
abstract: China’s live hog futures were launched on the Dalian Commodity Exchange on 8 January 2021, marking an important step towards stabilizing the hog industry and mitigating price volatility. In May of the same year, the Chinese government began releasing monthly hog product reports as a primary source of public market information. This study aims to examine whether the live hog futures market responds to these reports. Using an event study approach and regression analysis, we find no statistically significant market response to either the release or unanticipated information of hog product reports. Robustness tests further support this finding. To explore potential reasons for the limited market response, we analyse the structural characteristics of China’s live hog futures market. Compared with mature agricultural futures markets, the live hog futures market exhibits low market activity, poor liquidity, and high volatility – conditions that may hinder its ability to absorb and reflect public information efficiently. In particular, the high-threshold contract size appears to be a key constraint on market quality. Our results offer practical insights for exchanges and regulators seeking to optimize futures contracts and enhance the informational efficiency of futures markets.
abstract_zh: 中国生猪期货于2021年1月8日在大连商品交易所上市，标志着稳定生猪产业、缓解价格波动的重要举措。同年5月，中国政府开始按月发布生猪产品报告，作为公共市场信息的主要来源。本研究旨在考察生猪期货市场是否对这些报告产生反应。通过事件研究法和回归分析，我们发现无论是报告发布本身还是其未预期信息，均未对市场产生统计上显著的影响。稳健性检验进一步支持了这一结论。为探究市场反应有限的原因，我们分析了中国生猪期货市场的结构性特征。与成熟的农产品期货市场相比，生猪期货市场存在市场活跃度低、流动性差、波动性高等问题——这些条件可能阻碍其有效吸收和反映公共信息。其中，高门槛的合约规模似乎是制约市场质量的关键因素。本研究结果为交易所和监管机构优化期货合约、提升期货市场信息效率提供了实践启示。

title: Legacies of liberation: political dynamics in Civil War refugee camps
title_zh: 解放的遗产：内战难民营中的政治动态
title_primary: 解放的遗产：内战难民营中的政治动态
title_secondary: Legacies of liberation: political dynamics in Civil War refugee camps
authors: Diego Ramos-Toro
abstract: This paper traces the evolution of political outcomes in Civil War refugee camps, where roughly 600,000 enslaved African Americans achieved freedom. Refugee camps became sites of African American empowerment after the war, but these accomplishments were followed by a backlash that overturned the progressive outlook by the early 1900s. Despite the backlash, African Americans enjoyed persistently higher rates of literacy in counties home to refugee camps, fostering a sustained, selected outmigration of whites and enabling improved interracial relations. Today, progressive politics enjoy an advantage at these sites of former emancipation, and whites are key contributors to this progressive outlook. Overall, while progressive achievements may provoke backlash, they can also set in motion the very conditions that eventually erode resistance and foster renewed political progress.
abstract_zh: 本文追溯了美国内战难民集中营中政治结果的演变，约60万被奴役的非裔美国人在这里获得了自由。战后，难民集中营成为非裔美国人赋权之地，但这些成就随后遭遇反弹，至20世纪初，进步前景被颠覆。尽管存在反弹，但曾设有难民集中营的县中，非裔美国人的识字率持续较高，这促进了白人选择性迁出的持续现象，并改善了种族间关系。如今，在这些曾经的解放之地，进步政治占据优势，而白人是这一进步前景的关键贡献者。总体而言，尽管进步成就可能引发反弹，但它们也能催生最终削弱阻力、推动政治进步重新发展的条件。

title: Shareholder power and tax avoidance: evidence from geographic concentration of institutions
title_zh: 股东权力与避税行为：基于机构地理集中度的证据
title_primary: 股东权力与避税行为：基于机构地理集中度的证据
title_secondary: Shareholder power and tax avoidance: evidence from geographic concentration of institutions
authors: Lihui Tian Xiaoyang Yang Libin Qin a Nankai University, Tianjin, Chinab School of Economics, Nankai University, Tianjin, Chinac School of Accounting, Zhongnan University of Economics and Law, Wuhan 等
abstract: This study examines the impact of the expanding power of institutional shareholders on corporate tax avoidance. We measure shareholder power using the geographic concentration of institutional shareholders that affects tax aggressiveness. Our findings suggest that shareholder power is negatively associated with tax avoidance, as it constrains managerial opportunistic behaviours. The effect is more pronounced for firms in weaker external monitoring environments, with lower CEO shareholdings, more management with a financial background, and more long-term and foreign institutional shareholdings. In addition, shareholder power facilitates higher tax revenue collection. This study contributes to the nascent stream of research on the impact of institutional collective governance effectiveness, which is essential for monitoring managerial opportunism related to tax avoidance.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了机构股东权力扩张对企业避税行为的影响。我们利用机构股东地理集中度来衡量股东权力，这一因素影响税收激进程度。研究结果表明，股东权力与避税行为呈负相关，因为它约束了管理层的机会主义行为。在外部监督环境较弱、CEO持股比例较低、管理层中具有金融背景的人员较多以及长期和外国机构持股比例较高的公司中，这一效应更为显著。此外，股东权力促进了税收收入的增加。本研究为关于机构集体治理有效性影响的新兴研究领域做出了贡献，这对于监督与避税相关的管理层机会主义行为至关重要。

title: Semiparametric Bayesian estimation in an ordinal probit model with application to life satisfaction across countries, age and gender
title_zh: 有序Probit模型的半参数贝叶斯估计及其在跨国、年龄与性别生活满意度中的应用
title_primary: 有序Probit模型的半参数贝叶斯估计及其在跨国、年龄与性别生活满意度中的应用
title_secondary: Semiparametric Bayesian estimation in an ordinal probit model with application to life satisfaction across countries, age and gender
authors: Justin L. Tobias, Timothy N. Bond
abstract: We employ a novel semiparametric Bayesian ordinal probit model to re-examine the relationships between age and life satisfaction (“happiness”) across countries and gender. Within our ordinal choice framework we introduce a new scheme for cutpoint simulation and develop a locally adaptive method for smoothing an otherwise erratic collection of age dummy variable coefficients. We find strong evidence that employment status is deeply intertwined with the reported happiness of men, that employment status is relatively more important for men than it is for women, and that the common use of quadratic models to report ages when happiness is minimized can produce inference that is inaccurate and misleadingly precise. We also find evidence that refines the “U”-shaped pattern between age and happiness that has been reported and/or debated in this literature: For men in most of the European countries we consider, happiness is found to rise sharply before traditional retirement age and then into the beginning of retirement, followed by a flattening or decline in the right-tail of the age distribution. Often-used models that are quadratic in age fail to reproduce this pattern and are frequently at odds with the data.
abstract_zh: 我们采用一种新颖的半参数贝叶斯有序概率模型，重新审视了不同国家和性别间年龄与生活满意度（“幸福感”）之间的关系。在我们的有序选择框架内，引入了一种新的切点模拟方案，并开发了一种局部自适应方法来平滑原本不稳定的年龄虚拟变量系数序列。我们发现强有力的证据表明，就业状态与男性报告的幸福感紧密相关，且就业状态对男性的重要性相对高于女性；同时，常用二次模型来报告幸福感最低点年龄的做法，可能导致推断不准确且误导性地精确。我们还发现了细化该文献中已报道或争论的年龄与幸福感之间“U”形模式的证据：在我们考察的大多数欧洲国家中，男性的幸福感在传统退休年龄前急剧上升，并延续至退休初期，随后在年龄分布的右尾部分趋于平缓或下降。常用的年龄二次模型无法重现这一模式，且常常与数据不符。
